title: Spectral Prioritized Sweeping in Nonstationary Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.06186v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prioritized Sweeping (PS) accelerates model-based reinforcement learning by selecting backups according to Bellman residual magnitude. In nonstationary reward settings, however, the canonical priority score is shortsighted: after a localized reward shift, residuals propagate only through realized backups, so bottlenecked or topologically distant state estimates may remain static under a limited replanning budget. We introduce the Graph Topology Augmentation framework, which employ the graph's resolvent and its diffusion semantic, to augment the inquired signal. Our application, Graph Topology Augmentation for Prioritized Sweeping (GTA-PS), or which the alias Spectral Prioritized Sweeping (SPS) might be more universal, provides a drop-in ordering score for the setting of fixed dynamics and changing state rewards. translated_title: 非平稳强化学习中的谱优先扫除
translated_abstract: 优先扫除通过根据贝尔曼残差大小选择备份操作来加速基于模型的强化学习。然而，在非平稳奖励设置中，经典的优先级评分是短视的：在局部奖励发生偏移后，残差仅通过已执行的备份进行传播，因此在有限的重新规划预算下，处于瓶颈位置或拓扑距离较远的状态估计可能保持不变。我们引入了图拓扑增强框架，利用图的预解算子及其扩散语义来增强被查询的信号。我们的应用，用于优先扫除的图拓扑增强（GTA-PS），或其更为通用的别名谱优先扫除（SPS），为固定动态和变化状态奖励的设置提供了一种即插即用的排序评分。GTA-PS 使用平滑化的策略，诱导出一个转移链，并结合其入拉普拉斯算子和出拉普拉斯算子。标准的优先级键被增强……
tldr: 该论文提出谱优先扫除（GTA-PS/SPS），利用图的预解算子与扩散语义来增强优先级信号，解决了非平稳奖励环境下经典优先扫除因残差传播受限而导致的重新规划短视问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Spectral Prioritized Sweeping (GTA-PS/SPS), which leverages the graph's resolvent and diffusion semantics to augment priority signals, addressing the shortsightedness of canonical prioritized sweeping in nonstationary reward settings where residuals propagate only through realized backups.
